we are the first to propose an end-to-end model for CTR prediction with a shared input to the “wide” and the “deep” parts of the model, which can be easily applied on raw features and achieves state-of-the-art performance on both benchmark data (KDD Cup 2009) and commercial data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible for an end-to-end model to achieve the best of both worlds: deep learning and factorization machines.
, it is possible to learn sophisticated feature interactions in a neural network architecture without the need of expert feature engineering, by simply using raw features.
, by leveraging factorization machines in a neural network, it is possible to build a model that can capture both lowand high-order feature interactions in an end-to-end fashion.
